Grade: Grade 3
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 2.1: Independent reading

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Independent reading, part of READING in Grade 3 LITERACY ACTIVITIES.

B. At home with your parent or guardian
